nom: Rael Miracle Patch Retinol Spot Cover

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin notes the patches stick well for 12+ hours despite oil, which is often an issue for her with other brands.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, redness, or reaction even with retinol included, though this is based on a handful of accounts.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive, combination skin reports no irritation and calls the patches safe for her skin type.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her mid-40s and another switching birth control in her late 30s report the patches work on adult hormonal breakouts and occasional whiteheads.

concerns.aging: Not directly discussed by reviewers in terms of fine lines or firmness; mentions of age relate mainly to hormonal acne onset in the late 30s-40s rather than aging skin per se.
concerns.dehydration: Not mentioned by reviewers; no reports of dryness or moisture loss from use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling by morning after overnight use; one reviewer specifically credits the retinol/niacinamide combination for calming inflamed spots.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers with sensitive or retinol-reactive skin report no irritation or barrier disruption, including one who feared a retinol reaction but had none.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers dealing with dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or sun spots report gradual fading or reduced visibility over days of use; however, at least two reviewers say the patches did not improve older or established dark/sun spots.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report visibly smaller, flatter, or resolved blemishes overnight or within a couple of days, including cystic and hormonal types; a small minority (2 reviewers) report no improvement on a stubborn pimple after a week or two sheets.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the patches drawing out pus, oil, and gunk from active blemishes, which is presented as a visible and satisfying effect rather than a complaint about oily skin generally.

aspects.libelle: Draws out pus and gunk overnight
Patches fall off or slide before bed
Thin and nearly invisible under makeup
Good value for number of patches included
Leaves sticky residue or pulls hair if left too long

extraits.texte: I love this product and it works amazingly as long as you don't put anything on your skin before applying it. I wasted 5 or 6 of them the first day I used them because I followed the directions and used moisturizer prior to applying. They all fell off before I even went to bed. I've now started applying them to clean dry bare skin and they stay on all night. They are now my favorite pimple patches. I have cystic acne and they really prevent them from getting out of hand. They are also reasonably priced compared to other brands.
These are my favorite acne patches! I've tried so many brands and these work the best. I have sensitive skin and these don't cause any irritation!

extraits.titre: These patches are worth the hype!
extraits.texte: I get occasional breakouts and these patches have been a lifesaver! After cleansing, I stick a patch on before I sleep and by morning, it's sucked out all the fluids with no irritation. I have sensitive, combination skin so I love that it's safe to use.

I've tried multiple pimple patches, including those from Hero, and I find these Miracle Patch Retinol Spot Covers very similar. I've used them on whiteheads and on pimples that I want to prevent, and they have been effective in both cases. Of course, it's not magic, but after about 2 days, my blemishes become practically nonexistent. I have oily skin, so I often have issues with patches not sticking well, but that hasn't been a problem with these. The quality is great—they stay put for 12+ hours without issues. Highly recommend!

These patches have been a total game changer! If I catch a spot early, the retinol patches stop my hormonal pimples from fully developing after just 1–2 nights. I have sensitive skin and can sometimes react to retinol, but I haven't had any issues with these.

I was so excited to try this Retinal Spot Cover because I think that it is a wonderful product. Unfortunately, it did not work for me. I have finished 2 sheets and still haven't seen any improvement with my sun spots. Those patches were really sticked to my face though and that was great. I just wished it worked for me.

Been using these for a week now on the same pimple as soon as it came out its been very stubborn and has not taken any puss yet. Glad i didnt pay full price for these the truly ones worked way better. Still wearing them waiting to see if it eventually works.
